title: [review] provisioning.py:315: render_get reports stale state
description: The ProvisioningSession.state field is set once at creation (line 491) to ProvisioningState.IDLE and never updated. Meanwhile, the actual state is tracked in session.session.state (the underlying BRProvisioningSession or NodeProvisioningSession). The render_get method reports session.state.name.lower() which will always be 'idle' even when the channel is ESTABLISHED or COMPLETED. Should use session.session.state instead.
